title: Protocol coverage manifest
description: T6 M3 batch 7 (review round 1 adds excluded_sections and verified_at). Maps every mandatory protocol/rule currently governing this repository to its trigger, full-body path under docs/governance/protocols/ (or, for production authority, the governing CHARTER.md section), governing decision, decision record, and enforcing code/tests. Every level-2 and level-3 CLAUDE.md heading is either a row here or an excluded_sections entry naming its reason. authority_active stays false and the router generated from this file stays inactive until the founder-gated M4 cutover. Checked by scripts/protocol-coverage-lib.mjs (npm run protocols:coverage). No row here changes any protocol's substance -- CLAUDE.md remains the sole authority for the mirrored rows; docs/company/CHARTER.md remains the authority for production authority.

authority_active.description: This manifest and the router generated from it carry no authority until the founder-gated M4 cutover.

verified_at.description: The date every row and every excluded_sections entry was last verified against CLAUDE.md and the other source files. The router generator reads this value rather than a hardcoded literal.

excluded_sections.description: Every level-2 or level-3 CLAUDE.md heading that is not a protocol row: a section header grouping other subsections, project or reference description, or a rule this repository cannot check (for example Notion conduct). Each entry names the exact heading text and the reason it is excluded. Checked by scripts/protocol-coverage-lib.mjs for HEADING_UNCLASSIFIED (a level-2/3 heading neither covered by a row nor listed here) and EXCLUSION_STALE (a listed heading no longer in CLAUDE.md).

heading.description: The exact CLAUDE.md heading text (without the leading '#' markers), matched verbatim against a level-2 or level-3 heading.

reason.description: One sentence: why this heading is not a protocol row.

id.description: Stable kebab-case protocol id, used as the router's anchor and never renamed once a row exists.

trigger.description: One sentence: when a session must load this protocol's full body, drawn from the protocol's own trigger or scope text.

full_body.description: Repository path to the protocol's complete text. Must exist.

source.description: Where full_body's text is copied from: a CLAUDE.md heading (for the ten mirrored rows) or another document's section heading (production authority: a docs/company/CHARTER.md heading).

decision.description: The governing decision id (e.g. DEC-20260320-B), or the literal "none" when no numbered decision governs this protocol.

decision_reason.description: Required when decision is "none": why no decision id governs this protocol.

decision_record.description: Path under docs/decisions/records/ for the governing decision, or null when no formal record file exists for it.

decision_record_note.description: Required when decision_record is null: where the decision is recorded instead (CLAUDE.md and/or Notion).

enforced_by.description: Repository paths of the code, scripts and tests that enforce this protocol. Each must exist. May be empty only alongside enforced_by_note.

enforced_by_note.description: Required when enforced_by is empty: states the protocol is enforced by review alone.
